description: This file defines a modular script for a video processing pipeline using ultralytics YOLO models. It loads a video file, extracts the first frame, runs object detection for bears, dogs, and giraffes, then crops detected objects, and performs classification and pose estimation on each crop. The script includes utility functions for loading models, executing detection, filtering results, and summarizing outputs. It orchestrates the entire process via a 'run' function, orchestrated with command-line execution logic.
